run_async_rpc_client_server: run an asyncio-based RPC client-server test using moolib.Rpc with TCP transport
test_async_rpc_call: test async RPC calls by sending messages from client to host and awaiting responses
test_sync_rpc_call: test synchronous RPC calls using client.sync to invoke remote functions and get results
test_async_callback_rpc: test async callback-based RPC calls using client.async_callback with a response handler
test_rpc_error_handling: test RPC error handling for non-existent hosts, missing functions, and dead connections
